name: Card
source:
Hero has a tarot fortune-telling business with another girl Yusa Hikaru as his partner and one day he gets in a road crash on his bike. He regains consciousness in a hospital room and his nurse is a junior high school student Saki Koizumi. 
How will he develop this triangular relationship?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄与另一名女孩游佐光合作经营塔罗算命生意，有一天他骑自行车遭遇车祸。他在病房里苏醒，他的护士是初中生小泉早纪。
他将如何发展这段三角关系呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-june-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
